title: Gobluson - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Gobluson in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Gobluson is a fire-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Defense (B), Agility (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Gobluson
sections.content:
Location: Coastal Cave - merchants.

Obtained from Coastal Cave - merchants.

sections.title: Is the Gobluson Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (B), Agility (C). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
